name: critic-loop
description: Bounded writer⇄critic refinement executed by loop unrolling (ADR-016, ticket 14.3): a writer agent drafts, a critic agent reviews in strict JSON, and a marked loop edge — the only sanctioned cycle — sends the run back to the writer while the critic asks for revisions, up to max_iterations. Each iteration is a fresh cloned instance ({id}#k) spliced in via ExpandRun; the critic's verdict is auto-appended to the run thread (14.2) and the writer's role carries a 'conversation view' context preset (the critic-filtered thread), so every revision addresses the prior notes. The loop condition (output.json.verdict) is the sole brancher; the exit edge is unconditioned — the before-splice keeps `publish` pending until the terminal iteration fires it. on_exhausted defaults to proceed (route to the exit edge); a run runs offline against a scripted mock critic.

writer.system: You are a writer. Draft or revise an article for the brief. If the conversation carries critique notes, address every one of them.

critic.system: You are a critic. Review the latest draft against the brief and decide whether it needs revision, responding in strict JSON.

config.prompt:
Write an article for this brief, addressing any critique notes in the conversation.

${{ run.params.brief }}
